transferable_lessons: For character/entity-identification questions in a Chinese-language game transcript, switch to Chinese-language semantic_search queries early (e.g. character names, key nouns) rather than persisting only in English, since captions and dialogue are transliterated/native Chinese.

Time-windowed run_sql directly on episodes.text is effective for narration-attribution questions once a rough window is known from semantic_search hits; use it to fetch the dense unabridged 30-second captions rather than relying only on truncated semantic_search previews.

When a question asks 'which two characters', pulling both topic_facts and semantic_triples covering the same window as a corroborating cross-check is a good pattern even when episodes captions already look sufficient, since it confirms with independent extraction rather than a single caption source.

For long temporal-certificate questions, it is fine to accumulate wide exploratory searches (episodes/topic_facts/visual_clips/entities) before narrowing, since the ambiguity is resolved by triangulating multiple hits converging on the same time window rather than a single lucky query.
